title: Majorana barycenter displacement in selected maximal first-order AC subspaces
scope: One specified analytical maximal first-order AC subspace at each N=2..20. Results for N>=5 are maximum candidates within those subspaces; no global maximum over all first-order AC states or all maximal subspaces is asserted.
sphereConvention: Unit stars; multiplicities counted. Root z maps to (2Re z,-2Im z,|z|²−1)/(1+|z|²); infinity maps north.
